c74object.name: lp.pvvv64~
c74object.description: lp.pvvv64~ generates variable-colour noise without overflow. Like lp.pvvv~, but computed in 64-bit integers, so low Hurst values no longer click; a look-ahead limiter (on by default) keeps the output within +/- 1.

method.name: int
method.description: In the 2nd inlet: NN factor. In the 3rd inlet: Limiter on/off, default on.

method.name: limit
method.digest: Turn the look-ahead limiter on (1) or off (0)
method.description: Turn the look-ahead limiter on (1) or off (0).

method.name: mode
method.digest: Set the mode: 0 native, 1 PPC, 2 Intel, 3 PC415 (overflow emulations)
method.description: Set the mode: 0 native, 1 PPC, 2 Intel, 3 PC415 (overflow emulations).

method.name: tattle
method.digest: Print the state of the object to the Max Console (double-click does the same)
method.description: Print the state of the object to the Max Console (double-click does the same).
